dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with multi-immune in vivo CAR therapy approach. The company has dosed the first patient in their MT-304 study as of April 2026.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First patient dosed in Phase 1/2 study of MT-304 targeting HER2-positive solid tumors. No specific efficacy or safety data disclosed in available sources.
dossier.indications_pursued: HER2-positive solid tumors based on the MT-304 program. No additional indications specified in the available data.
dossier.delivery_approach: Multi-immune in vivo CAR platform encompassing CAR-T, CAR-NK, and All-RNA RetroT technologies. Specific delivery mechanism not detailed in available sources.
dossier.key_differentiators: Multi-immune approach combining CAR-T, CAR-NK, and All-RNA RetroT platforms in a single in vivo system. Claims first-in-class status for their multi-immune in vivo CAR therapy.
dossier.last_significant_event: First patient dosed in Phase 1/2 study of MT-304 on April 23, 2026. Company also presented at AACR 2026 in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with in vivo gene therapy approach. Company has active programs in both gene editing and in vivo CAR-T applications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: TSRA-196 has advanced to Phase 1/2 clinical trial for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency in PiZZ genotype patients. New preclinical data in sickle cell disease program was presented at ASGCT 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency with lung and/or liver disease manifestations in clinical development. Sickle cell disease program in preclinical stage.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual platform approach combining gene editing capabilities with in vivo CAR-T technology applications. Focus on in vivo delivery eliminates need for ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of new preclinical data for sickle cell disease program and in vivo CAR-T advancements at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in April 2026.
Addition Therapeutics announced multiple oral and poster presentations at the ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T approach using viral vector delivery platform.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 dose-escalation study (NCT06528301) recruiting patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia using UB-VV111.
dossier.indications_pursued: B-cell lymphomas including large B-cell lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and multiple myeloma with dual-target approach (UB-VV500).
dossier.delivery_approach: Viral vector-based in vivo delivery platform with assets designated as UB-VV### suggesting proprietary vector technology.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual-target in vivo CAR-T approach for multiple myeloma (UB-VV500) representing potential advancement over single-target strategies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Announcement of UB-VV500 dual-target in vivo CAR-T data presentation at American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy Annual Meeting in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with asset CPTX2309 currently recruiting in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, focusing on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients, currently in recruiting status.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies with lead asset KLN-1010 currently recruiting patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT07075185) evaluating safety, tolerability, and recommended Phase 2 dose of KLN-1010 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma, specifically targeting relapsed or refractory disease.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology with KLN-1010 as the lead therapeutic asset.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquisition by Eli Lilly for up to $7 billion in April 2026, described as the largest in vivo CAR-T deal to date.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T platform across multiple trials. Currently recruiting patients for investigator-initiated single-arm studies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No disclosed clinical or preclinical data available from the provided information. All trials are in early exploratory phases focusing on safety and tolerability endpoints.
dossier.indications_pursued: B-cell malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell lymphoma, B-ALL, and multiple myeloma. Also pursuing refractory autoimmune diseases targeting CD19/BCMA.
dossier.delivery_approach: Injectable in vivo CAR-T platform with assets JY231 for B-cell targets and JY232 for multiple myeloma. Uses direct injection delivery mechanism.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual-target CD19/BCMA approach for autoimmune diseases represents potential differentiation. Injectable delivery format may offer advantages over traditional ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: Multiple trial initiations with NCT07490951 for autoimmune diseases being the most recent, though not yet recruiting as of the data cutoff.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical development with multiple trials testing HN2301 and HN2302 assets. Appears to be developing in vivo approaches for autoimmune diseases based on trial designs.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No clinical or preclinical efficacy data has been publicly disclosed. Multiple Phase 1 trials are evaluating safety and preliminary efficacy across autoimmune indications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma. One trial in refractory myasthenia gravis was terminated.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06801119 for HN2301 in systemic lupus erythematosus and scleroderma, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.indications_pursued: The company appears to be exploring CAR-T applications in oncology, hematology, and autoimmune disorders including systemic rheumatic diseases.
dossier.delivery_approach: The company is developing both viral and non-viral vector approaches for in vivo CAR-T generation, with emphasis on mRNA-based non-viral strategies and non-viral targeted integration methods.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on eliminating ex vivo manufacturing bottlenecks through scalable in vivo CAR-T production. Development of non-viral targeted integration technology for large DNA in primary human T cells without requiring double-stranded DNA breaks.
dossier.last_significant_event: Publication in Nature (April 2026) describing non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells independent of double-stranded DNA breaks.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing non-viral cell therapies through partnership with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI.
dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral delivery platform being developed through Center of Excellence collaboration.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on non-viral approaches to cell therapy development in partnership with established technology providers.
dossier.last_significant_event: Established Center of Excellence with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI for advanced non-viral cell therapy development in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical development with EN-374 as lead gene therapy asset for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting Phase 1/2 trial (NCT06876363) evaluating safety and potential efficacy of EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374, plus broader chronic granulomatous disease research through observational studies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 trial for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease (NCT06876363, currently recruiting).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T approach, as evidenced by active trials for SC262 and SC291 assets and preclinical development of SG293.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trials are active but not recruiting for SC262 in B-cell lymphomas and SC291 in both hematologic malignancies and systemic lupus erythematosus, though specific efficacy data has not been reported.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia, plus autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus and Type 1 diabetes.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology, with SG293 representing their in vivo CAR-T candidate and additional programs including hypoimmune cell therapies.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual focus on both oncology and autoimmune applications with the same in vivo CAR-T platform, combined with hypoimmune cell therapy approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 announcement of oral presentation featuring preclinical data from in vivo CAR-T candidate SG293 at ASGCT annual meeting.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with intramuscular delivery approach for solid tumor asset EVM14.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: EVM14 is in Phase 1/2 recruiting trial for selected solid tumors, administered intramuscularly alone and in combination with pembrolizumab.
dossier.indications_pursued: Selected solid tumors (EVM14), primary membranous nephropathy (EVER001), primary IgA nephropathy (Nefecon), and SARS-CoV-2 infection (PTX-COVID19-B).
dossier.delivery_approach: Intramuscular administration for EVM14 solid tumor asset; oral delivery for EVER001 BTK inhibitor.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is described as a highly selective, oral, reversible, covalent BTK inhibitor with high selectivity over other kinases for proteinuric glomerular diseases.
dossier.last_significant_event: EVM14 Phase 1/2 trial initiation for selected solid tumors with intramuscular delivery, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles targeting T cells.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Two Phase 1 trials currently recruiting, including a healthy volunteer safety study for ORN252 and a dose escalation study for TI-0032-III in autoimmune diseases.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome, with relapsed and refractory patient populations being targeted.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) that target T cells and encapsulate circular RNA encoding CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR).
dossier.key_differentiators: Use of circular RNA technology for in vivo CAR-T generation, which may offer advantages over traditional linear RNA approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trials for both ORN252 in healthy volunteers and TI-0032-III in autoimmune diseases, both currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing conventional CAR-T cell therapies, not in vivo approaches based on disclosed trials.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Three active clinical trials recruiting patients, including two Phase 1/2 studies for OriCAR-017 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma and one Phase 1/2 study for Ori-C101 in hepatocellular carcinoma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma (relapsed/refractory) and hepatocellular carcinoma, with focus on solid tumor applications.
dossier.delivery_approach: Conventional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy with OriCAR-017 targeting GPRC5D and Ori-C101 targeting GPC3.
dossier.key_differentiators: GPRC5D-targeting approach for multiple myeloma and GPC3-directed CAR-T for hepatocellular carcinoma with stated focus on solid tumor CAR-T development.
dossier.last_significant_event: $110 million pre-IPO financing round completed in April 2026 to advance solid tumor CAR-T pipeline ahead of planned public offering.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical development with ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy approaches across multiple solid tumor indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Commercial approval achieved for Zevorcabtagene Autoleucel in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, with Phase IV post-marketing studies and long-term follow-up trials now initiated.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma, with an approved hematologic indication in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell manufacturing and infusion, including CT041 targeting claudin18.2 and CT011 for hepatocellular carcinoma applications.
dossier.key_differentiators: Targeting claudin18.2 in solid tumors represents a differentiated approach for gastric and pancreatic cancers where this antigen is overexpressed.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of post-marketing Phase IV observational study and long-term follow-up study for commercialized Zevorcabtagene Autoleucel in 2024.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early clinical stage with both in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T approaches. Company has assets in Phase 1 trials with in vivo candidates IMV101 and IMV102, plus ex vivo CAR-T asset IMC002 advancing to Phase 3.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for IMV102 presented at AACR 2026 demonstrating durable tumor control in preclinical models. IMC002 has advanced to Phase 3 randomized trial in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma for in vivo assets. Solid tumors focused on CLDN18.2-positive digestive system cancers including gastric, pancreatic, and esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach with in vivo CAR-T delivery system for IMV101 and IMV102 assets. Traditional ex vivo autologous CAR-T manufacturing and infusion for IMC002 targeting CLDN18.2.
dossier.key_differentiators: Portfolio spans both in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T modalities across hematologic and solid tumor indications. Focus on CLDN18.2 targeting in solid tumors with advancement to Phase 3 stage.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of preclinical data for in vivo CAR-T candidate IMV102 showing durable tumor control at AACR 2026 conference in April 2026.
